owned_potion.name: Fairy in a Bottle
owned_potion.description: When your HP would be reduced to 0, instead this potion is discarded and you heal to 30% of your Max HP.

effect.live_rule: When your HP would be reduced to 0, instead this potion is discarded and you heal to 30% of your Max HP.
effect.timing_detail: Automatic while held; no manual use is needed. Consumed before healing for 30% of maximum HP, minimum 1 before modifiers. Later damage can still kill. Forced death, including Sandpit, bypasses this prevention.

synthetic_probe.scope: A copy of the saved combat with player HP changed to 1 and first intent to 30x2; no native state was changed and no model request or command was sent.

uncomputed_death_prevention.description: When your HP would be reduced to 0, instead this potion is discarded and you heal to 30% of your Max HP.
uncomputed_death_prevention.scope: Automatic ordinary-death prevention, consumed before healing. Trigger order, heal modifiers, repeated damage and remaining potion inventory are not simulated; do not infer final HP or survival from the damage sum. Forced death bypasses this effect.

implementation: Automatic potions are armed while held. Native Fairy prevents ordinary death, is consumed before healing, and heals max(30% max HP, 1) before modifiers. Sum-only damage cannot determine post-revival HP or survival; expose the dependency and conditional consumption. Sandpit force:true bypasses prevention. Other revival adapters are not claimed.

validation.command: node --test test/effect_lifecycle.test.mjs test/combat_arithmetic.test.mjs test/turn_projection.test.mjs test/turn_sequence.test.mjs test/context_compiler.test.mjs
